name: bilbo_swash_caps
description: Bilbo Swash Caps is a sister family to the normal Bilbo . It is very legible calligraphic style that has a masculine feel. This family is ideal for headlines and other display uses, while the normal Bilbo can also be used in body copy that requires added warmth to a message.
